name: v1.4.40
body:
## Security: eMudhra intermediate CA compromise

- **\`certifi>=2026.10.19\`** is now required. It drops trust in the compromised eMudhra/emSign CAs.
- Generated Dockerfiles and local \`bentoml build\` install **\`uv==0.13.4\` with \`--require-hashes\`** whenever uv is missing or older (uv < 0.13.4 bundles the compromised CAs). pip 26.2.2 is used where supported. (#5757)

**Action for users:** run \`bentoml build\` again with 1.4.40, then redeploy, so your bento image picks up the fixed certifi and uv.

## Also in this release

- Agent skills for creating BentoML projects and for deploying to Kubernetes and EC2 (#5705, #5683)
- Windows tar symlink extraction and fastai CI dependency resolution fix (#5689)
- Docs and CI updates (#5710, #5715, #5741, #5702, #5758, #5759, #5760)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bentoml/BentoML/compare/v1.4.39...v1.4.40
